sentences.en: The thunderstorm yesterday delayed the delivery of the mail.
sentences.zh: 1. 昨天的雷暴雨导致邮件投递延误。

sentences.en: The weather report said that there will be thunderstorms tomorrow evening.
sentences.zh: 2. 天气预报说明天傍晚会有雷暴雨。

sentences.en: The ominous thunderstorm in the distance was gaining speed and strength.
sentences.zh: 3. 远处预示着不祥的雷暴雨正在加快速度，增强威力。

phrases.zh: 1. 雷暴频发的；雷暴造成的

senses.zh: [气象] 雷暴；雷暴雨；大雷雨
